item.title: Krones cuts simulation run times by up to 98% with AI agents and Azure High-Performance Computing
item.description: Industry: Industrials and Manufacturing — “It was an outstanding experience on how quickly things can run with the right partners.”

item.title: Peterborough Regional Health Centre turns fragmented data into trusted insight
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “We started fairly simple by embedding Copilot on top of our analytics, letting people ask natural language questions of the data, and helping clinicians get curious without having to go learn how to code. This early work helped staff engage with data in a more accessible way while maintaining trust.”

item.title: Brown Health scales Microsoft Dragon Copilot and AI agents to ease care delivery
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “Now, I can focus on what I think is going on with you and hearing you and being with you. The documentation is happening in parallel with engagement with the patient.”

item.title: Central Coast Council serves 355,000 citizens anytime, anywhere with Surface 5G
